A '''battle''' was fought for control of the [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidian]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic forces ultimately won the battle, taking control of the city from the Separatists. The Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were aided in battle by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Suljo Warde]], who used his [[Precognition/Legends|precognitive]] abilities to predict Separatist actions.<ref name="Chronicles" />
